chapters.title: The Party
chapters.description: The annual dance at the Misses Morkan's house begins. Gabriel arrives with his wife Gretta.

chapters.title: The Conversation
chapters.description: Gabriel speaks with Lily the caretaker's daughter and feels uneasy about his remark.

chapters.title: The Dance
chapters.description: Gabriel dances with Miss Ivors and their conversation reveals his conflicted feelings about Ireland.

chapters.title: The Song
chapters.description: Aunt Julia sings 'Arrayed for the Bridal'. The music touches Gretta deeply.

chapters.title: The Supper
chapters.description: The guests enjoy supper. Gabriel prepares his speech for the occasion.

chapters.title: The Speech
chapters.description: Gabriel delivers his speech, touching on themes of Irish hospitality and memory.

chapters.title: The Revelation
chapters.description: Gretta tells Gabriel about Michael Furey, the young man who died for her love.

chapters.title: The Epiphany
chapters.description: Gabriel understands the truth about love and loss as he watches the snow fall.
